plain: To divide and share out, such as seats in Congress

webster.text: To divide and assign in just proportion; to distribute among two or more, a just part or share to each; as, to apportion undivided rights; to apportion time among various employments.

example.quote: But why should the number of individuals be the principle to apportion the taxes in each state, and to include in that number, women, children and slaves.
example.cite: Cato, Letter V, New York Journal
